newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper, nickel prices extend losses.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper, nickel prices extend losses.

text.p: Indian copper and nickel prices extended losses on Monday while other base metals were steady, dealers said.
Ready copper fell by 50 rupees to 11,750 rupees per quintal on fresh offerings following expectation that state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd may slash prices next month.
"It may reduce prices by 3/5 rupees per kg," said Sharad Parikh, President of Bombay Metal Exchange. Ready nickel fell by 300 to 38,000 rupees. Nickel was down by 200 rupees on Saturday.
Tin was unchanged at 35,500 rupees, zinc at 6,325 rupees and lead at 5,000 rupees. Aluminium was steady at 7,450 rupees.
